title: UrbanVLA: A Vision-Language-Action Model for Urban Micromobility
abstract: arXiv:2510.23576v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Urban micromobility applications, such as delivery robots, demand reliable navigation across large-scale urban environments while following long-horizon route instructions. This task is particularly challenging due to the dynamic and unstructured nature of real-world city areas, yet most existing navigation methods remain tailored to short-scale and controllable scenarios. Effective urban micromobility requires two complementary levels of navigation skills: low-level capabilities such as point-goal reaching and obstacle avoidance, and high-level capabilities, such as route-visual alignment. To this end, we propose UrbanVLA, a route-conditioned Vision-Language-Action (VLA) framework designed for scalable urban navigation. Our method explicitly aligns noisy route waypoints with visual observations during execution, and subsequently plans trajectories to drive the robot. translated_title: UrbanVLA：面向城市微出行的视觉-语言-动作模型
translated_abstract: 城市微出行应用（如配送机器人）需要在大规模城市环境中可靠地导航，同时遵循长程路线指令。由于真实城市场景的动态性与非结构化特性，这一任务极具挑战性，然而现有的大多数导航方法仍局限于短距离、可控的场景。有效的城市微出行需要两个互补层次的导航技能：低层能力（如目标点到达和避障）以及高层能力（如路线与视觉的对齐）。为此，我们提出了UrbanVLA，一个面向可扩展城市导航的路线条件化视觉-语言-动作（VLA）框架。该方法在执行过程中显式地将含噪的路线航点与视觉观测对齐，随后规划轨迹以驱动机器人。为了让UrbanVLA掌握这两个层次的导航能力，我们……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出UrbanVLA，一个路线条件化的视觉-语言-动作模型，通过在执行中将路线航点与视觉观测显式对齐并规划轨迹，实现了配送机器人等城市微出行应用在大规模动态城市环境中的可扩展长程导航。
en_tdlr: UrbanVLA is a route-conditioned Vision-Language-Action model that explicitly aligns noisy route waypoints with visual observations and plans trajectories, enabling scalable long-horizon urban navigation for micromobility applications such as delivery robots in large-scale, dynamic city environments.
